cfg.Index = idx
runner := NewRunner(cfg)
resolved, err := runner.registeredTools(phase)
assert err == nil
assert containsTool(resolved, "code_search")

tests.title: code_search is absent from the resolved tool set when Index is nil
given: a Config with a nil Index
a Phase whose BuiltinTools includes "code_search"
tests.when: registeredTools resolves the tool set
then: the resolved tool set does not contain a tool named "code_search"
the ReadOnlyFileTools are still present
tests.pseudocode:
cfg := fauxConfig(provider, ws)
cfg.Index = nil
phase.BuiltinTools = append(agentrun.ReadOnlyFileTools, "code_search")
resolved, _ := runner.registeredTools(phase)
assert !containsTool(resolved, "code_search")
for _, name := range agentrun.ReadOnlyFileTools {
  assert containsTool(resolved, name)
}
